messages:
Priya V: hey all, Priya here, first week on infra. trying to follow the observability onboarding but stuck on one dashboard. Grafana shows "You need permission to view this dashboard" when I open /d/inference-ops/latency-panel and Datadog log indexes seem empty for me (403 on the explorer). SSO is priya.v@redwood.ai

devex-bot: welcome @Priya V! post your email and the dashboards/projects you need. onboarding doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/observability-onboard. if urgent tag @Infra Observability :wave:

Sam H: hi @Priya V congrats and welcome. two quick checks: 1) try incognito to rule out cookie loops, 2) verify Okta groups include redwood-observability. i can add you to grafana-viewers and datadog-log-read. do you need edit or view?

Priya V: thanks @Sam H. tried incognito, same permission error. Okta shows me in redwood-engineers and redwood-observability. view is fine for now (don't need edit).

Sam H: ok i'll kick a SCIM provisioning sync and bump Grafana ACLs for you. running the quick command now:

```
okta sync user --email priya.v@redwood.ai --service grafana && okta sync user --email priya.v@redwood.ai --service datadog
```

Sam H: also adding you to grafana-folder: inference and datadog role datadog-log-read. should take ~2-3m to propagate.

Grafana Bot: Provisioning update for priya.v@redwood.ai: Grafana folder membership applied (inference), dashboard ACL refreshed (viewer).

Priya V: i can load the grafana dashboard now 389, latency panels look good. Datadog log explorer still gives 403 when i open it.

Sam H: weird. can you run this API check from your laptop (replace token from vault):

```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "DD-API-KEY: <workspace-token>" "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/logs-queries/list"
```

Priya V: returns 403. i used the token from the vault entry observability/workspace-token.

Sam H: thanks. i've manually granted datadog-log-read to priya.v@redwood.ai in the identity service (race earlier today caused some assignments to queue). try again in 60s.

Infra Observability: also invited @Priya V to the Sentry project inference-runtime-prod (project-view). check email for invite.

Priya V: Datadog explorer works now and Sentry invite accepted. huge thanks! quick question: who owns the inference-ops/latency-panel if i want to propose adding p95/p99?

Sam H: owners are infra-observability. small visual tweaks are fine via a PR to repos/infrastructure/grafana-dashboards with the exported JSON. alert threshold changes need a short approval from infra-observability to avoid noise. ping #observability-dashboards when you open the PR and tag @Infra Observability for review.

Priya V: perfect. i'll open a tiny PR for p95/p99 lines and include reasoning about reducing false positives. thanks again for the speedy help :heart:
